working_title: Beyond Smooth Numerical Embeddings: Discovering Sparse Exact-State Interactions in Tabular Deep Learning
claim: Numerical columns can contain smooth ordinal structure and supported discrete state semantics; nested residual-ANOVA discovery can add sparse exact-state views while abstaining when they are unsupported.

fixed_method.interaction_definition: joint residual map after backfitting and projecting out both weighted singleton marginals
fixed_method.deployed_encoder: support-gated train-vocabulary one-hot singleton and crossed states; unseen states map to zero
fixed_method.selection_order: greedy held-out utility per log(1 + state cardinality) under the state budget

untouched_stage1.source: TabArena-v0.1 official r0 folds at commit 84093d633a78c641fb6d1b24dad8fe6b5a25af97

required_controls: cardinality-matched random singleton and pair states
non-nested selection as an optimism diagnostic
raw, periodic, and learned-spline numerical embeddings
required_analysis: predicted discovery utility versus downstream test gain
dataset bootstrap intervals and per-dataset paired results
training time, inference time, memory, dimensions, and parameter matching
stop_rule: Do not claim an ICLR-level method if the untouched Stage-1 screen gate fails; retain the result as a mechanistic case study.
